scene_report.narration_text: In March 2024, Kendrick Lamar ignited a massive controversy by rejecting the idea of a rap Big Three.
His verse on Like That asserted there was only one king, prompting Drake to fire back with Push Ups.
Kendrick responded with the six-minute diss track Euphoria, escalating the tension between the two artists.
The conflict turned personal when Drake released Family Matters, making explosive allegations about Kendrick's private life.
scene_report.main_action: Lying on a desk with an embossed seal

scene_report.narration_text: Less than an hour later, Kendrick shocked the industry with Meet the Grahams, firing back with disturbing claims.
On May 4, Kendrick dropped the devastating track Not Like Us, accusing Drake of serious misconduct.
Although Drake denied the allegations, the song became a global anthem that millions danced to.
Ultimately, a track created to destroy a rival won five Grammy Awards, cementing this as an unforgettable hip-hop rivalry.
